summary: Iteration 2 regression + new features PASSED. Backend: 28/28 pytest cases pass — auth (register/login/me), password >=8 rule, brute-force throttle (5 wrong → 429 on 6th; success resets counter), SSRF guard blocks 127.0.0.1/0.0.0.0/169.254.169.254 while allowing 192.168.1.50 & 10.255.255.1, server CRUD (no password leak, verify_cert/alerts_enabled/webmin_url present), offline detection for 10.255.255.1, check-one & check-all, per-server alerts toggle persists, offline transition alert created & clearable, history endpoint returns list, settings CRUD reflected in /auth/me, register-push requires auth (401 no token, 201/500/502 with token). Frontend (mobile web, 390x844): register→dashboard→empty state→add server with HTTPS+VerifyTLS toggles→red OFFLINE card→detail with CPU/RAM/DISK gauges (dashes when offline), CPU%/RAM% sparklines with 'Collecting data…' placeholder, per-server alerts toggle, sticky Open Webmin Panel; bottom tabs GRID/ALERTS/SYSTEM navigate; Settings poll segmented 5m/15m/30m/1h selectable + Save shows 'Saved ✓'; logout returns to login. Fixed 1 critical backend NameError (undefined `verify` in httpx.AsyncClient) that would otherwise have broken every online check.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 301 previously referenced an undefined variable `verify` inside httpx.AsyncClient(verify=verify,…) — this would raise NameError on every server check and silently mask it as 'check failed' via the outer try/except. Fixed to `verify=srv.get('verify_cert', False)` so the per-server verify_cert toggle actually takes effect.

rca_of_issue: Critical fix: server.py line 301 used `verify=verify` with no such variable in scope. The NameError was swallowed by the outer try/except (line 338), causing every server.check_server() to short-circuit with error='check failed' and online=False. Impact: any real Webmin server would appear offline even when reachable, and the per-server verify_cert toggle would have no effect. Mitigation: replaced with `verify=srv.get('verify_cert', False)` so httpx honours the per-server TLS verification setting. Verified with 28 passing tests including SSL checks on private-LAN hosts.
